keywords: Primary Court land dispute – Possession – Magistrate’s order – Indefinite status quo order – Security/bond – Persons who were not parties also ordered to enter bonds – Scope of Magistrate’s powers – Section 70 permits directions concerning security for possession but not indefinite maintenance of status quo – Order against non-parties without hearing violates natural justice – High Court correctly removed unlawful conditions – Appeal dismissed.
